messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

To do anything with your orders, I first need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **the email address on your account**.  
(If you prefer, tell me **first name + last name + ZIP code** instead.)

After that, I’ll need:
1) The **order ID** for the **speaker return**  
2) The **order ID** for the **17-inch laptop** order to change it to **13-inch**

Fine. The email is aarav.santos8321@example.com. I don’t have the order IDs in front of me, so you’ll have to look them up by my email. Just hurry up and check my recent orders for the speaker and the 17-inch laptop.
Error: User not found

I tried looking up your account using **aarav.santos8321@example.com**, but I couldn’t find a matching user.

Please reply with **either**:
1) The **correct email address** on the account, **or**
2) Your **first name + last name + ZIP code** (so I can look you up that way).
Unbelievable. Try aarav.santos8320@example.com then. That’s the only other one I use. Just get on with it and find my orders already.
